# document-utils runtime stack — original MIT implementation.
# Every package below is permissively licensed; no GPL/AGPL package is imported.
# Scripts import third-party libraries inside the functions that use them, so
# -h / --help / --version answer on a host where none of these is installed.
# Licences were read from distribution metadata and licence texts, not assumed;
# the per-package readings are recorded in the commit that introduced this file.
#
# External programs, NOT pip packages (invoked via subprocess only):
#   LibreOffice (soffice)  MPL-2.0  — conversion, thumbnails, formula recalculation
#   Tesseract + pytesseract Apache-2.0 — optional OCR of scanned pages (pytesseract
#     is imported by no script; install it only when the OCR route is used)

# PDF: forms, page surgery, geometry, rendering, images, creation
pypdf>=7            # BSD-3-Clause — field extraction/filling, annotations, merge/split/rotate/encrypt
pdfplumber          # MIT — word/line/rectangle inventory, table extraction
pypdfium2>=5        # Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause — PDFium page rendering (bundled PDFium BSD-3-Clause)
Pillow              # MIT-CMU — validation overlays, crops, thumbnail grids
reportlab           # BSD-3-Clause — PDF creation recipes

# DOCX: creation and the validate.py / accept_changes.py round-trip check
python-docx         # MIT — writes the package; optional for the unpack/edit/pack road

# PPTX: reading a packaged deck (thumbnail.py) and deck creation
python-pptx         # MIT — slide inventory, hidden-slide flag, text extraction

# XLSX: workbook read/write and the recalc.py verdict
openpyxl            # MIT — cached values and formula counts; never evaluates formulas

# Optional XML hardening: used by office/ooxml.py when importable; without it the
# stdlib path still refuses every DTD/entity declaration before parsing.
defusedxml          # PSF-2.0

# Transitive, pulled in by the above (listed for licence visibility, not pinned):
#   lxml BSD-3-Clause, typing_extensions PSF-2.0, XlsxWriter BSD-2-Clause,
#   pdfminer.six MIT, charset-normalizer MIT, cryptography Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause
